title: VIIRS Geoportal: Uzbekistan nighttime-light monitoring and reproducibility code
description: Google Earth Engine application source, offline replay script, and frozen derived CSV diagnostics. Interactive gap-filled monitoring is distinguished from frozen QA0 analyses. Independent nighttime field validation has not been completed. See README for external input and asset requirements.
